Each entry temporarily exempts ONE designated source file (services/main, services/backend, sidecar/ai/routing, sidecar/runtime) that is not reachable from the STATIC test import graph. Entries are debt markers and the list must strictly shrink: expired entries fail, and entries whose file becomes statically reached (or a shim, or removed) fail and must be deleted. Every entry needs: path (repo-relative, forward slashes), label (unique), reason, expires_on (YYYY-MM-DD), plan_doc. Seeded 2026-06-13 with six services/main boot-only composition modules; ALL SIX were resolved 2026-06-13 by adding focused extract-and-inject behavioral unit tests (tests/{packaged-smoke,setup-readiness,startup-audit,comet-overlay-controller,main-window-composition,runtime-service-composition}.test.js), each directly require()-ing its module so the static require-graph now reaches it.
